issue.title: Mac CaptureAliasTipPanelTests.testSecondEligibleSigilInASessionShowsNoTip times out waiting for the first tip on some CI runs

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by bob-cli-jf.1.1 (note #6, agent bob-cli-jf.1.1--3) while verifying the bob-mac-capture history restore; triaged by the bob-cli-jf.1 lander.

- FAIL: exact-SHA macOS CI run 42813392077 at restored master af604c6d9e05ec6440bfce5fa15ced97e388035c (https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/42813392077). The test timed out waiting for its first tip (9.595s), then the didShowTip/tipsShown assertions failed as a cascade.
- PASS: run 42816665790 at direct child 28aa5b32a62011266459e13723236e4caeda2478 (https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/42816665790) passed in 0.679s. That child only changed CaptureEditorHighlightTests.swift, so the production code and this test file were identical between the two runs.
- CaptureAliasTipPanelTests.swift and the alias sources match pre-incident GOOD 29147289 exactly, so the restore did not cause this.
- Fail rate: 1 of 2 observed CI runs. It has not been reproduced serially or locally (it is macOS-only, so GitHub Actions is the only gate). The precise cause is unproven. The pattern (waiting on the first tip under CI load) matches other Mac UI timing flakes such as bob-cli-hv, bob-cli-hu, and bob-cli-jb, but it is a different test and wait.
- Evidence artifacts: file:explicit:9c06ef579a77645b1ef8134e (original failure log) and file:explicit:56505b5871a0c00d9ec89aa2 (green run and source comparison).
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: scripts/dev/macos-ci-check (bob-mac-capture exact-SHA macOS CI, swift test)
